title: This Open-Source AI Tool Replaces 200+ Subscriptions
description:
Comment 200 and I'll send you the link.

Stop paying subscriptions for every AI tool just to make good videos. There's a new open-source project that gives you an interface where you can literally control the shot — close-up or wide, blurred background or sharp, like you're directing a camera.

Inside, you get access to 200+ models for images, video, and lip-sync: Flux, Kling, Sora, Veo, Nano Banana, all in one place. It's similar to Higgsfield, but instead of paying a monthly subscription, you just pay per generation with tokens.

For e-commerce, this means you can shoot a full product campaign — hero shots, lifestyle videos, talking-head ads — without juggling five different tools and five different bills.

#ai #aivideo #opensource #ecommerce #aitools
